pattern_explanation: Spanish and English both borrowed many words from Latin and Greek, so some Spanish words look like English ones. Over time, the meanings of some of these look-alikes drifted apart, so the spelling stays close while the meaning changes.
false_friend_warning: The Spanish word libreria looks like the English word library, but it means bookshop. The Spanish word for a library is a different word, so students should not translate library by looking at the spelling.
